definitions.explanation: An area designated for washing, especially the space in a Japanese bathroom where you wash your body before entering the bathtub, or a sink/washing area in a kitchen or workplace.

examples.english: Wash your body in the washing area.

examples.japanese: ⟦{温泉|おんせん}→温泉：04117_onsen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{洗|あら}い{場|ば}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦シャンプー→シャンプー：04507_shanpuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{置|お}いてあった→置く：01092_oku⟧。
examples.english: There was shampoo at the washing station in the hot spring.

examples.japanese: ⟦レストラン→レストラン：01048_resutoran⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{洗|あら}い{場|ば}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{皿|さら}→皿：00883_sara⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{洗|あら}う→洗う：00827_arau⟧⟦アルバイト→アルバイト：01528_arubaito⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I have a part-time job washing dishes in the restaurant's wash area.

notes:
FORMS:
{洗|あら}い (washing) + ⟦{場|ば}→場：03699_ba⟧ (place).

USAGE:
Most commonly refers to the washing area in a Japanese-style bathroom (⟦{風呂場|ふろば}→風呂場：28822_furoba⟧), where bathers wash and rinse before entering the ⟦{浴槽|よくそう}→浴槽：04985_yokusou⟧ (bathtub). In Japanese bathing culture, you always clean yourself in the {洗|あら}い{場|ば} before soaking in the tub. Also used for commercial dish-washing areas in restaurants.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{風呂場|ふろば}→風呂場：28822_furoba⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{洗|あら}い{場|ば} (bathroom washing area)
- {洗|あら}い{場|ば}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{流|なが}す→流す：01968_nagasu⟧ (to rinse off in the washing area)
